messages.text: I hear you, and I want you to know that guilt is such a heavy feeling to carry around. It takes courage to even acknowledge it. Would you feel comfortable sharing a little about what's been weighing on you? I'm right here and I'm listening. 💛

That guilt sounds really heavy, and I'm glad you're sharing it with me. It's okay to still be feeling this way — healing and processing things takes time, and you don't have to rush yourself. Can you tell me a little more about what's been weighing on you most today? I'm here and I want to understand. 💙
